rationale: Realistic but entirely synthetic NSCLC patients (FHIR R4) for chart-scan input and as an answer key built from the structured record. Every value is simulated. Labels P-001.. are assigned deterministically (birth date, then Synthea id) in Interim's participant label space; whether a chart is attached to the seeded kiosk participant with the same label is decided by the seed/API, not here (data/synthetic/synthea/README.md).
